title: First captain gives economic destabilization as reason for secrecy

tellings.quote: why is this whole thing being kept secret and he talked about economic destabilization

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says that in the early 1990s the National Security Agency, the US government's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, trained him to communicate with aliens. When he asked his first commanding captain why the whole thing was kept secret, the captain is said to have answered: economic destabilization. Michels retells this from Sherman's own account, which would mean officials feared the news itself would shake the economy.
